title: Placement slice of S9: instruction columns, event names, service levels and the freshness message text are not published
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.3 fill order; legacy RWB-E6-031; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4; context pack S9
section: 11 Data; 12.3; 12.5; 14 Validation and messages; 9 State transitions
description: One combined row for every value the placement story needs and no source read for WP B2-S9-004 gives: the column list and field IDs of partner_instruction and partner_user and the seventh field of partner; the names behind the legacy identifiers EV-20 and EV-21; the service level of each instruction type by partner type, which is the partner clock; the text of the data-freshness answer (MSG-P1-001 in the wave 4 key); and the instruction status vocabulary beyond SENT. The S9 module FSD and TSD are not in the extract set of this WP, so their field lists and validation rules could not be read.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-031 Data table lists partner DF-PRT-001 to DF-PRT-007, assignment, decision_log_entry, v_ace_score and rule_row, and no partner_instruction row; the context pack lists partner, partner_instruction and partner_user as S9's three tables without columns; the context pack lists events EV-20 and EV-21 without names; no source read for this WP publishes a service level per partner type or the MSG-P1-001 text.
proposed: Confirm the column list with the DB story of S9 and the data dictionary owner, the two event names with the event catalogue owner, the service levels with the panel story of FEAT-PRM-02, and take the MSG-P1-001 text from the platform message catalogue; close the row when the S9 FSD and TSD enter the extract set.

title: Placement contract of S9: request body, element property names, status vocabulary and four consumed operation names are not published
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.3 and R7.2 (s12); legacy RWB-E6-031; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 APIs sheet; context pack S9
description: One combined row for every value the contract baseline needs and no source read for WP B2-S9-004 gives: the body of the placement request and the property names of the Instruction and Partner elements; the instruction status vocabulary; the operation names of the case read, of the two rwb-source-data products and their freshness, of the scorecard rule read and of the session read; the error set of the three operations beyond the three legacy messages and the text of the data-freshness answer.
evidence: The APIs sheet gives the method, the path, the purpose, the module and the access of the three operations and no element list; the legacy story gives two of the endpoints only; the context pack gives the six operation paths of the service and no element list; the wave 4 key records that the InstructionRequest body is not published.
proposed: Fix the request body and the property names in the baseline review as design and record the decision, confirm the four consumed operation names with their owners, and take the message texts from the platform catalogue.
